summary: Corebridge Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce its 2026 annual meeting date of September 16, 2026, record date of July 28, 2026, and updated deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations due to the meeting date differing by more than 30 days from the 2025 annual meeting. No price, premium, terms, board recommendation, or advisor is provided. This is purely a scheduling and procedural update, not a special situation. There are no deal mechanics, risk-arb angle, or regulatory clock to monitor.
